reviews.method: Read-only rulesAudit 30-day snapshot plus individual review of all 43 canonical core/extended anchors and detector limits. Test/QA excluded. No bypass row met the review threshold. Zero eligible field blocks supplies no false-block rate. Keep verdicts preserve current text, scope, enforcement and wiring; low-hit candidates remain open effectiveness questions, not automatic demotions.

entries.evidence: Immutable variable-delete safeguard; observed hits establish detector activity, not universal safety coverage.
Immutable origin requirement; retained commands/near-negatives must distinguish trusted local scripts from unknown downloads.
Immutable credential isolation; zero findings does not establish that scanning is unnecessary.
Unbounded writes and destructive schema actions have different contracts; preserve predicate prohibition and rollback authorization.
Preserve bounded home/config access; no reliable generic detector or field benefit denominator was established.
Keep current-session verification and evidence scope; artifact disposal observations cover only one part of V1-V4.
Keep exact task ownership and exemptions for runtime-owned paths; recency alone cannot authorize deletion.
The parser repair produced RED before implementation; retain type-specific pre-change evidence rather than demanding a bug reproduction for every change.
Retain fresh terminal validation after the last change; zero fingerprint hits is not semantic proof of all completion claims.
The parser object-only restriction and the isolated read-only tmp mount had distinct reproduced causes; retain root-cause-before-patch discipline.
Shares the specificity bucket; do not double-count it as independent effectiveness evidence. Keep failure-to-fix linkage.
Recovery tests still need disposable filesystem fixtures; no case supports moving this obligation out of the ordinary workflow.
Keep relevance and exact successful-read evidence. Block observations do not establish all denials were correct; no bypass review threshold was met.
Task-record recovery is necessary when context is lost; the event stream does not provide a reliable semantic opportunity denominator.
Keep the final-report fallback and repository opt-in boundary; do not create memory entries solely to satisfy a detector.
Keep the advisory observer with its limitation: ordinary rg is not mechanical validation, and an expired flag does not identify a bad completion claim.

Zero findings over 10 evaluated sessions satisfies the candidate floor but supplies no counterfactual evidence for demotion. The previous review requested opportunity analysis; that causal gap remains open, so retain with an explicit unresolved evidence limit rather than claiming value proved.
Two evaluated sessions are below the opportunity floor. Keep the known-red remote observer distinct from full local or missing evidence.

Zero order hits over 19 evaluated sessions describes reports under the current rule. It does not show removal preserves complete disclosure; retain current core residence pending paired behavioral evidence.
Keep reasons for uncertainty and bounded claims; the detector observes only selected phrasing, not general truthfulness.
Keep concrete evidence anchors and merged bugfix telemetry attribution; raw hits do not measure user benefit.
Keep proportional planning at L2+; transcript calibration remains a structural proxy and cannot justify promotion or removal.
The release visibility symptom repeated across three versions; retain cheap history checks without treating recurrence alone as a proven remote root cause.
Preserve operation-scoped authorization and reuse. A concrete CI edit remains separately reviewable; task level alone must not create a permission gate.
Retain risk-based planning depth for shared/default/authorization changes and its separation from permission.
Pre-change git status protects existing work; structural sampling cannot see all shell writes or previous-turn checks.
Keep accounting for changed files and temporary fixtures; a tmp-count proxy does not prove completion.
The parser review explicitly covers string/object/dynamic and exact/shared/direct/unpaired paths; preserve branch-sensitive acceptance.
Keep one canonical trigger list with on-demand extended procedures; no paired evidence supports changing discovery or load triggers.
Immutable transport verification; registry propagation is not a reason to disable TLS checks.
Inherited secrets signal; preserve credential-file exclusion and do not count the same bucket as a second independent result.
Immutable Git ownership boundary; ordinary Git commands already support this task without manual internal edits.
Emergency ordering does not waive safety or evidence follow-up; no emergency case was measured in this review.
Keep explicit trigger/scope/non-trigger routing boundaries; no routing change or representative benefit claim is made.
Optional plugin instructions cannot grant scope or override safety; retain without treating plugin lifecycle as native activation proof.
The parser full gate completed before runtime testing. Retain validated dependent phases while permitting independent read-only preparation.
Retain independent local, hosted, artifact and release closure evidence; this local task is not release authorization.
A fixture, a real-model diagnostic and a complete canary prove different tiers; retain this explicit distinction.
Keep risk-tiered metadata review; no global routing change is proposed or validated by this cadence review.
Keep the core binding reachable for ordinary tasks and distinguish legitimate waits from unsupported next-turn completion claims.

Zero proxy hits over 15 evaluated sessions cannot justify demoting the ownership/sweep rule. Hook removal also lacks a reviewed residue sample and before/after user-latency evidence; retain with the unresolved value question explicit.
Keep named scope for category-level cleanup and tracked deletion; existing hard-tidy and clear-create cases guard opposite authorization errors.
Keep explicit adjacent-work scope handling. The canonical auth-scope-bound-adjacent case now exists; the old manifest note about no case is historical, not a current coverage conclusion.
